defaultText: Do not send money, deposits, fees, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or transfers based on this request.
Do not share passwords, login details, banking credentials, or other account secrets.
Do not share one-time passwords or security codes.
Do not open or install the attachment until you verify it through a trusted independent channel.
Avoid using the link in the suspicious message; navigate to the organization or service independently if you need to verify something.
Verify the claim through an official channel you find independently, not through contact details supplied in the suspicious message.
If this appears to come from someone you know, contact that person through a separate trusted channel before acting.
Open the service's official app or type its known official website yourself instead of following the provided link.
Do not grant remote access. If a remote-access session is already active, disconnect it before continuing verification.
If you confirm the account or message is suspicious, use the platform's built-in report or block controls.
If money or banking information may already be involved, contact the financial institution using an official channel you find independently.
